Hi Ashley — great speaking with you a few minutes ago. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can lock a focused technical walkthrough: 

Recap (30m discovery):
- Primary goal: validate Redwood inference latency and cost savings over current self-hosted GPU endpoints for batch scoring and low-latency chat.
- Data constraints: MedicaHealth requires VPC/private deployment for PHI; KMS integration is mandatory.
- Success metrics: 95th-percentile latency under 300ms for short chat turns; token cost reduction target 3–4x.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical walkthrough (deep dive) where we’ll:
- Show an end-to-end demo on a representative sample (prefix caching + quantized model path)
- Review network & KMS integration checklist
- Walk through rollout strategies (canary / autoscale) and observability dashboards

I can host two options next week — please pick whichever fits your engineering roster:
1) Tue Dec 22 — 10:00–11:15 AM ET (14:00–15:15 UTC)
2) Wed Dec 23 — 3:00–4:15 PM ET (19:00–20:15 UTC)

Please confirm which slot works and who will join from your side (engineering, infra/security, procurement if you want contract-level questions). I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link + agenda and attach a short agenda PDF.

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (draft agenda)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally once you confirm.

Best,
